 L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration LA 2026 red carpet: Eva Longoria, Ariana Greenblatt, Kristen Bell and more 
 By 
 Mekhi Seabrook 
 Published 
 Nov. 18, 2026, 10:47 p.m. ET 
 The 2026 L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration was held at The Ebell on November 18 in Los Angeles, California. Attendees included Eva Longoria, Ariana Greenblatt, Kristen Bell, Andie MacDowell and more. Below, see all the stars’ best looks on the red carpet.
